verdict.rationale: Puzzle is a SaaS accounting platform, so letting users opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, usage-tracking controls or privacy settings; the items cover bookkeeping, AI features, exports, the MCP integration and UI preferences such as dark mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
